items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: Sammy Cahn wrote the lyrics to that song... Sammy Cahn has, inadvertently, of course, written, or used the same title that he had used for another song, with which, you know, that he had collaborated with Nicholas Bronsky on.

ctx.x: An interesting thing about that song, "Only Trust Your Heart" -- I don't know that I've told you about that before, but Sammy Cahn wrote the lyrics to that song.
